description:
I’ve been getting a lot of messages from deployed soldiers lately 🇺🇸
…and Kevin was one of them 💬

He reached out to me while deployed 🌍
and told me he’ll be coming home in about 60 days 🙏

All he wanted?
A beautiful home to start his newlywed life with his wife 🏡💍

Within 36 hours ⏳
we found him an AMAZING deal
✨ unbelievable interest rate
✨ FREE appliances
✨ perfect home to start their next chapter

This is why I love what I do 🤍

Helping someone secure a home
while they’re serving our country…
just hits different 🇺🇸❤️

Kevin, I cannot wait for you to come home safely 🙏
Your home is waiting for you 🏡✨

#FortHoodHomes #KilleenTX #TexasRealtor #MilitaryHomebuyers #VALoan
